program_model.instance_model: perforated-panel identity signs A/B/C (panel sizes) + bracket-arm footer signs D/E

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A rigid perforated-aluminum identity panel clamped to an existing building column with stainless band clamps and turnbuckle tensioners (non-penetrating), with flat-cut aluminum letters stud-mounted to the panel. A projecting bracket-arm variant epoxy-anchors to masonry.
knowledge.rationale: Band-clamp-to-column avoids drilling historic masonry, and the perforated face cuts wind load on a column-mounted panel.

structure.construction: 1x1x1/8in aluminum tube frame, 1/8in perforated aluminum face, 1x1x1/8in angle perimeter retainer, #8 countersunk screws
1/4in flat-cut aluminum letters, stud-mounted to panel
Band-It stainless steel band clamps with turnbuckle tensioners top and bottom (non-penetrating)

dimensions.note: bracket-arm variant: 2x2x3/16in arm + gussets, 3/8in plate, epoxy-set studs to masonry

craft_observations: Non-penetrating band-clamp mount protects historic masonry.
Perforated face mitigates wind load on a column-mounted panel.
